trigger_event_or_exception: waitingApprovalCount > 0 on Inbox load
message_content: Items are awaiting your approval in Open Office (using plain language, zero raw AWAITING_HITL token).
remediation_action: Click Review in Open Office (1.1.1.1.2.1) to approve or request rework in <= 2 steps.

trigger_event_or_exception: S7 Success on Read / Snooze / Preferences save
message_content: Notification updated. Use Undo within 10 seconds to restore it to unread.
remediation_action: Click Undo (Hoan tac) if marked by mistake.

notice_name: Channel or Inbox Sync Failure Notice
trigger_event_or_exception: Telegram/Email dispatch failure or HTTP >= 400 on Inbox API
message_content: Delivery failed (see error summary). Your changes remain safe; check channel link or retry.
remediation_action: Relink Telegram account (/telegram/account/link) or retry dispatch.

trigger_event_or_exception: HTTP 400/422 missing title or invalid columnId/assigneeUserId
message_content: Cannot save work item: check title length and verify the target column belongs to this project.
remediation_action: Correct highlighted field and resubmit.

parent_component: 1.2.1.1.1 Active Work Items Board & List View
trigger_event_or_exception: column item count >= project_column.wipLimit (warn/strict wipMode)
message_content: This column has reached its Work-in-Progress limit. Complete or move an item before adding more.
remediation_action: Finish existing items or confirm override if soft-warn mode is enabled.

notice_name: Issue Status Updated With Undo Notice
parent_component: 1.2.1.1.1 Active Work Items Board & List View
trigger_event_or_exception: S7 Success on POST /issues or PATCH /issues/:issueId
message_content: Work item saved. Click Undo within 10 seconds to revert status change.
remediation_action: Click Undo (Hoan tac) to restore previous column.

trigger_event_or_exception: minutes <= 0 or invalid spentOn date
message_content: Enter a positive number of minutes (at least 1) and a valid date.
remediation_action: Update minutes/date and resubmit.

trigger_event_or_exception: GET /sync/rev advances while drawer is open
message_content: Another teammate or agent updated this item. The latest revision is now shown.
remediation_action: Review updated fields before saving edits.

trigger_event_or_exception: Circular predecessor link attempted or self-dependency POST /issues/:issueId/links
message_content: Dependency rejected: circular or summary-row links are blocked to preserve valid schedule order.
remediation_action: Link leaf tasks only without forming a closed cycle.

trigger_event_or_exception: endDate <= startDate or window overlaps existing active cycle
message_content: Selected dates overlap another cycle or end before starting. Pick a distinct window.
remediation_action: Adjust startDate/endDate to non-overlapping days.

trigger_event_or_exception: POST /cycles/:cycleId/finish or cycle creation success
message_content: Cycle updated cleanly. Incomplete items rolled over to your selected next cycle.
remediation_action: Review velocity summary or start the queued cycle.

trigger_event_or_exception: Empty title or targetDate < startDate
message_content: Target completion date cannot be earlier than the initiative start date.
remediation_action: Set targetDate >= startDate and retry.

trigger_event_or_exception: S5 Empty state when active/proposed initiative list has 0 rows
rule_or_policy_ref: FR-045, IAD S5 Empty State Contract
message_content: No active initiatives are scoped yet. Create an initiative to roll up milestone progress.
remediation_action: Click + New Initiative (1.2.4.1.1.2) to start.

trigger_event_or_exception: Missing name or invalid layout payload
message_content: Please provide a dashboard name and select at least one valid KPI widget.
remediation_action: Enter valid name and choose a layout preset.

trigger_event_or_exception: S6 Partial analytics API failure or empty dataset
message_content: Telemetry values are sanitized to 0% when upstream series are unavailable; never shows NaN.
remediation_action: Click Refresh or check API connection status.

trigger_event_or_exception: HTTP 423 Locked when editing a locked spec or missing title
message_content: This document is locked by its owner. Unlock it or duplicate a working draft first.
remediation_action: Request unlock or use Duplicate document.

trigger_event_or_exception: OT collaboration step committed cleanly
message_content: All changes synced to revision history cleanly.
remediation_action: No action required.

notice_name: Path Traversal or Read Error Notice
trigger_event_or_exception: Outside-workspace path or binary file >10MB upload rejected
message_content: Access denied or file exceeds 10MB preview limit. Only approved workspace paths are readable.
remediation_action: Choose a valid file inside active workspace zones.

trigger_event_or_exception: Orphan USE_CASE_SLICE count > 0 vs clean state == 0
message_content: UTOP Graph Integrity: warns immediately if any Use Case slice lacks upstream/downstream linkage.
remediation_action: Run UTOP Alignment Repair or link missing slice before sealing.

parent_component: 1.3.4.1.1 Sticky Note Boards & Kara Action View
trigger_event_or_exception: S7 Note board or meeting capture persisted
message_content: Note saved to workspace board cleanly.
remediation_action: Convert action notes to Work Items when ready.

trigger_event_or_exception: Agent transitions state between working, waiting approval, or standby
message_content: Telemetry refreshed: shows live verified runs without synthetic idle busywork.
remediation_action: Select a standby agent to assign the next contract.

trigger_event_or_exception: S7 Success HTTP 200/201 from POST /api/vibe/open-office/contracts
message_content: Task contract dispatched cleanly to lead agent. Live run telemetry is now streaming.
remediation_action: Open Contracts tab to monitor proof evidence or wait for approval ping.

notice_name: Dispatch Missing Title or Lead Agent Notice
trigger_event_or_exception: Empty title or invalid lead_agent_id on dispatch
message_content: Contract could not be created: enter a clear objective title and pick a lead AI agent.
remediation_action: Focus title input, supply objective, and retry dispatch.

trigger_event_or_exception: Bulk dry-run preview completed or batch dispatch finished
message_content: Bulk dry-run ready: review validated items and confirm batch dispatch.
remediation_action: Inspect batch summary or clear invalid lines before dispatching.

trigger_event_or_exception: Contract transitioned to RETURNED_FOR_REWORK
message_content: Rework requested and permanent lesson rule saved to prevent repeat mistakes.
remediation_action: Lead agent will submit the next run once fixes are verified.

trigger_event_or_exception: SegregationOfDutiesError: approver_id == lead_agent_id
message_content: Independent Review Required: the author who executed this contract cannot approve their own work.
remediation_action: Escalate approval to an independent human reviewer or lead orchestrator.

parent_component: 1.4.3.1.1 SLA, Rework & Chain Hash Telemetry View
trigger_event_or_exception: Fallback numeric guard activated on empty/corrupted division denominator
message_content: Telemetry metrics automatically sanitize missing counters to 0 so dashboards never show NaN.
remediation_action: Normal during cold start; counts populate automatically as contracts execute.

trigger_event_or_exception: handleRemovePosition or handleUnseatAgent invoked
message_content: Position or seat cleared. Click Undo (10s Undo window) to restore previous assignment.
remediation_action: Click Undo within 10 seconds to revert the removal or unseat action.

trigger_event_or_exception: Unlinked modelCredentialId or duplicate @username
message_content: Agent handle already exists or model credential is missing. Configure credential in Vault/Integrations.
remediation_action: Choose unique username or link active credential in JTBD-6 Vault.

trigger_event_or_exception: Always displayed in slim <=76px agentic-os-harness-banner
message_content: Want live room operations and task contract supervision? Open the 8-department Open Office workspace.
remediation_action: Click Open Office CTA (btn-mode-open-office) when ready.

trigger_event_or_exception: Malformed 5-field cron string or empty prompt
message_content: Cron syntax is invalid (expected 5 fields such as '0 9 * * 1-5').
remediation_action: Pick a preset interval or fix the cron expression.

trigger_event_or_exception: Schedule saved or Run Now triggered (POST .../run)
message_content: Schedule updated. Next trigger queued in agent runner.
remediation_action: Inspect live logs in Agent Runs history.

parent_component: 1.5.3.1.1 Connected Skills, MCP & Scalar API View
trigger_event_or_exception: Always displayed beside API key / MCP snippet areas
message_content: Secret tokens remain masked in shared MCP manifests; generate or reveal personal keys inside Secret Vault.
remediation_action: Open Secret Vault (/vault) to rotate or authorize API credentials.

trigger_event_or_exception: HTTP 503 Vault daemon offline on 127.0.0.1:8765
message_content: Unable to reach the local Secret Vault service. Verify port 8765 health and retry.
remediation_action: Restart headless vault server or click Retry.

trigger_event_or_exception: Member or Viewer attempts to reveal/rotate apiKeyCiphertext or integration secret
message_content: Access Restricted: only Workspace Owners or Admins can view or rotate encrypted credentials.
remediation_action: Request credential rotation from your team Owner.

trigger_event_or_exception: Email already active member or pending team_invite exists
message_content: An invite is already pending or this user already belongs to the team.
remediation_action: Resend existing invite from the Members table or verify email.

trigger_event_or_exception: Role permission upsert or invite issued cleanly
message_content: Workspace access policy updated and reflected immediately.
remediation_action: Test new role check if configuring custom grants.

trigger_event_or_exception: S7 Success on Company/Vault/Governance update
message_content: Organization settings and encrypted custody preferences saved.
remediation_action: No action required.

trigger_event_or_exception: consecutiveFailures >= threshold on outbound webhook
message_content: Webhook endpoint suspended after repeated HTTP failures. Verify receiver URL and secret.
remediation_action: Check GET /webhooks/:webhookId/deliveries trace and re-enable webhook.

notice_name: Agent Stream Interrupted With Retry Notice
trigger_event_or_exception: SSE chat stream failure or timeout
message_content: The agent stream paused unexpectedly. Your prompt is preserved—click Retry.
remediation_action: Click Retry last message or cancel in-flight run.

trigger_event_or_exception: Thread finishes streaming turn and updates agent_chat_usage
message_content: Turn complete — concise token footer reflects actual context window usage.
remediation_action: Start a fresh thread if context nears cap.

trigger_event_or_exception: Drawer opened on /inbox (Step 1) or /<team>/<project> (Step 2..6)
message_content: Highlights 'You are here' in the 6-step delivery loop using accessible primary border emphasis.
remediation_action: Follow the highlighted next step or click Org Settings.

notice_name: Invalid Credentials or Locked Account Notice
trigger_event_or_exception: HTTP 401/403 wrong password or deactivated SCIM user
message_content: Email or password is incorrect, or account access was paused.
remediation_action: Check spelling, use Forgot Password (/forgot-password), or contact Owner.

parent_component: 2.3.2 User Locale, Theme & Start Page Form
trigger_event_or_exception: S7 Success on PATCH /account/preferences
message_content: Personal theme, language, and start page preferences saved cleanly.
remediation_action: Reload any open workspace tab to verify updated strings.
